set.about.title: About
set.about.intro: NoteRecall turns a meeting recording into a transcript with a speaker on every line, in Malay, English or both mixed together.
set.about.step.1: Record the meeting with anything: a phone, Teams or a voice recorder.
set.about.step.2: Drop the file on the Home screen. It starts straight away.
set.about.step.3: Wait while it works. You see each stage and about how long is left, and you can close the tab.
set.about.step.4: Review the transcript. The player follows along, and you can rename each speaker.
set.about.local: Local uses Whisper large-v3 on this computer. Audio never leaves it, timestamps are exact, and it copes best with Malay and English mixed in one sentence. Expect about 13 minutes per hour of audio on a GPU and about 24 on a CPU.
set.about.cloud: Cloud uses Google Gemini, and your recording is uploaded to Google. Only the words come from Gemini. Timing is rebuilt here and is off by about 2 seconds, up to 7 at worst.
set.about.limit.1: When two people talk at once, the words go to the louder voice. One microphone records one mixed sound.
set.about.limit.2: If you know how many people spoke, set the number. It beats Auto, which can split one voice into several in an echoing room.
set.about.limit.3: Very distant or quiet voices may be missed if a person could not hear them either.
set.about.data_text: Each meeting has its own folder inside the data folder, with plain audio, JSON and Markdown files. Deleting a meeting deletes that folder.

setup.why.python: NoteRecall runs on Python 3.10 or newer.
setup.why.core: The part that runs the app in your browser.
setup.why.ffmpeg: Converts recordings so they can be read.
setup.why.disk: Recordings and models need room to be saved.
setup.why.cuda: Optional. Makes transcription much faster on an NVIDIA graphics card.
setup.why.whisper_model: The speech model itself. A large download, once.
setup.why.seg_model: Finds where each person starts and stops talking.
setup.why.gemini_key: Needed to use the Gemini cloud engine.

set.spk.title: Speaker detection model
set.spk.hint: Works out who is speaking on each line. It always runs on this computer, whichever transcription engine you use.
set.spk.model.desc: pyannote segmentation 3.0 with TitaNet-large voice matching, run through sherpa-onnx.
set.spk.count.title: Default speaker count
set.spk.count.hint: Fills the speaker option on the Home screen. If you know how many people spoke, set the number: it beats Auto.
set.sum.title: Summary writer
set.sum.hint: Writes the Summary tab of each meeting. It works on the finished transcript and does not depend on the transcription or speaker settings.
set.sum.ollama.desc: AI-written summaries from a model running on this computer. Used whenever Ollama is found.
set.sum.builtin.desc: Picks the key sentences and shows speaking time. Always available, with nothing to install.
set.sum.gemini_note: The Gemini key in Transcription is used only to transcribe. Summaries never use it and never leave this computer.
